grammar.explanation: 我也看足球，也跳舞 presents two included activities. It does not make the activities simultaneous. State the same subject clearly; distinguish preferences from performed actions.

examples.py: wǒ yě kàn zú qiú , yě tiào wǔ .
examples.en: I watch football and also dance.

examples.zh: 她也喜欢比赛，也喜欢慢慢练。
examples.py: tā yě xǐ huān bǐ sài , yě xǐ huān màn màn liàn .
examples.en: She likes competitions and also slow practice.

examples.py: tā yě xué hàn yǔ , yě xué rì yǔ .
examples.en: He studies Chinese and also Japanese.

commonMistakes.wrong: 也看足球，也跳舞说明同时做。
commonMistakes.right: 也看足球，也跳舞说明两项都有，不一定同时。
commonMistakes.why: Parallel inclusion does not establish simultaneity.

grammar.explanation: 又高兴又紧张 describes two co-occurring feelings. 又快又准 combines speed and accuracy in the stated action, not every future action. Do not replace negative uncertainty with an invented positive trait.

examples.py: tā yòu gāo xìng yòu jǐn zhāng .
examples.en: She is both happy and nervous.

examples.py: zhè cì dòng zuò yòu kuài yòu zhǔn .
examples.en: This movement is both fast and accurate.

examples.py: zhè duàn wǔ yòu qīng sōng yòu yǒu qù .
examples.en: This dance passage is both relaxed and interesting.

commonMistakes.wrong: 她又高兴又紧张，所以只高兴。
commonMistakes.right: 她又高兴又紧张，两种感受都有。

lines.py: nǐ jīn tiān yào qù kàn bǐ sài ma ?
lines.en: Are you going to the match today?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 去，我们班有人参加决赛。你一起去吗？
lines.py: qù , wǒ men bān yǒu rén cān jiā jué sài . nǐ yì qǐ qù ma ?
lines.en: Yes. Someone from our class is in the final. Would you come too?
lines.speaker: b

lines.py: shì shén me bǐ sài ? zú qiú ?
lines.en: What kind of match? Football?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 篮球。她平时跳舞，最近也一直在练球。
lines.py: lán qiú . tā píng shí tiào wǔ , zuì jìn yě yì zhí zài liàn qiú .
lines.en: Basketball. She normally dances, but she's been practising basketball lately too.
lines.speaker: b

lines.py: nà wǒ qù . jǐ diǎn kāi shǐ ?
lines.en: I'll come. What time does it start?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 三点。我们两点半在门口见，早点找位置。
lines.py: sān diǎn . wǒ men liǎng diǎn bàn zài mén kǒu jiàn , zǎo diǎn zhǎo wèi zhì .
lines.en: Three. Let's meet at the entrance at two thirty to get seats early.
lines.speaker: b

lines.py: tā men xiàn zài pái míng dì yī ba ?
lines.en: Her team's ranked first now, right?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 对，不过今天的对手也很强。上次只赢了两分。
lines.py: duì , bù guò jīn tiān de duì shǒu yě hěn qiáng . shàng cì zhǐ yíng le liǎng fēn .
lines.en: Yes, but today's opponents are strong. They won by just two points last time.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 那我们多带一点水，别光顾着喊。
lines.py: nà wǒ men duō dài yī diǎn shuǐ , bié guāng gù zhe hǎn .
lines.en: Let's bring extra water and not just keep shouting.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 还有你答应带的面包。我可记着呢。
lines.py: hái yǒu nǐ dā yìng dài de miàn bāo . wǒ kě jì zhe ne .
lines.en: And the bread you promised to bring. I haven't forgotten.
lines.speaker: b

reading.title: Read one result at a time
reading.blurb: An original scene written for this course.
reading.purpose: Follow the situation, the problem and what happens next.

lines.zh: 下午两点半，我和朋友在门口见面。她抱着两瓶水，我带着一袋面包，一起进了体育馆。
lines.py: xià wǔ liǎng diǎn bàn , wǒ hé péng you zài mén kǒu jiàn miàn . tā bào zhe liǎng píng shuǐ , wǒ dài zhe yī dài miàn bāo , yì qǐ jìn le tǐ yù guǎn .
lines.en: At two thirty I met my friend at the entrance. She had two bottles of water; I brought bread. We entered the sports hall together.

lines.zh: 比赛开始以后，我们班的队很快领先。朋友高兴得站起来，我拉她坐下，后面的人还要看。
lines.py: bǐ sài kāi shǐ yǐ hòu , wǒ men bān de duì hěn kuài lǐng xiān . péng you gāo xìng de zhàn qǐ lái , wǒ lā tā zuò xià , hòu miàn de rén hái yào kàn .
lines.en: Our class's team soon took the lead. My friend stood up excitedly; I pulled her down so those behind could see.

lines.zh: 第二节，对手把分数追上来了。朋友说今天可能要输，我说还有时间，先把面包吃了。
lines.py: dì èr jié , duì shǒu bǎ fēn shù zhuī shàng lái le . péng you shuō jīn tiān kě néng yào shū , wǒ shuō hái yǒu shí jiān , xiān bǎ miàn bāo chī le .
lines.en: In the second quarter the opponents caught up. My friend thought we might lose. I said there was time left, so let's eat first.

lines.zh: 最后一分钟，两队只差一分。我们都不说话了，连水也忘了喝。比赛结束的时候，我们班领先三分，终于赢了。
lines.py: zuì hòu yī fēn zhōng , liǎng duì zhǐ chà yī fēn . wǒ men dōu bù shuō huà le , lián shuǐ yě wàng le hē . bǐ sài jié shù de shí hou , wǒ men bān lǐng xiān sān fēn , zhōng yú yíng le .
lines.en: With one minute left, the teams were a point apart. We fell silent and forgot our water. At the finish, our class was three points ahead and had won.

lines.zh: 同学出来以后，第一件事是问有没有吃的。我们把剩下的面包给她，她一边吃一边说今天比上次还紧张。
lines.py: tóng xué chū lái yǐ hòu , dì yī jiàn shì shì wèn yǒu méi yǒu chī de . wǒ men bǎ shèng xià de miàn bāo gěi tā , tā yī biān chī yī biān shuō jīn tiān bǐ shàng cì hái jǐn zhāng .
lines.en: Our classmate came out asking for food. We gave her the remaining bread. She said today's game had been even more tense than last time.

lines.zh: 回去路上，朋友说下次她也想试试。我说可以，但别只练站起来喊，那可不算上场。
lines.py: huí qù lù shàng , péng you shuō xià cì tā yě xiǎng shì shì . wǒ shuō kě yǐ , dàn bié zhǐ liàn zhàn qǐ lái hǎn , nà kě bù suàn shàng chǎng .
lines.en: On the way home my friend wanted to try playing next time. I told her not to practise only standing and shouting: that didn't count as playing.

choices: Their class wins after a tense finish
Their class loses before it starts

lines.py: zhè shì shàng cì shì jiè bēi de lù xiàng .
lines.en: This is a recording of the previous World Cup.

lines.zh: 几位选手已经准备好了。
lines.py: jǐ wèi xuǎn shǒu yǐ jīng zhǔn bèi hǎo le .
lines.en: Several competitors are ready.

lines.zh: 那位选手来自我们学校。
lines.py: nà wèi xuǎn shǒu lái zì wǒ men xué xiào .
lines.en: That competitor is from our school.

lines.py: dì di měi zhōu liù liàn zú qiú .
lines.en: My younger brother practises football Saturdays.

lines.zh: 这场足球比赛几点结束？
lines.py: zhè chǎng zú qiú bǐ sài jǐ diǎn jié shù ?
lines.en: When does this football match finish?

lines.zh: 孩子从椅子上跳了下来。
lines.py: hái zi cóng yǐ zi shàng tiào le xià lái .
lines.en: The child jumped down from the chair.

lines.py: nǐ xiān bié tiào , xié hái méi chuān hǎo .
lines.en: Don't jump yet; your shoes aren't on properly.

lines.py: tā yǐ qián liàn guò tiào gāo .
lines.en: He used to practise the high jump.

lines.py: tiào gāo bǐ sài xià wǔ kāi shǐ .
lines.en: The high-jump competition begins this afternoon.

lines.py: tā cóng xiǎo jiù xǐ huān tiào wǔ .
lines.en: She's loved dancing since childhood.

lines.zh: 你愿意和我一起跳舞吗？
lines.py: nǐ yuàn yì hé wǒ yì qǐ tiào wǔ ma ?
lines.en: Would you like to dance with me?

lines.zh: 这次跳远的成绩比上次好。
lines.py: zhè cì tiào yuǎn de chéng jì bǐ shàng cì hǎo .
lines.en: This long-jump result is better than last time.

lines.zh: 跳远比赛结束以后，他去找教练。
lines.py: tiào yuǎn bǐ sài jié shù yǐ hòu , tā qù zhǎo jiào liàn .
lines.en: He went to his coach after the long-jump competition.

lines.py: wǒ men cóng zhè lǐ yóu dào nà biān .
lines.en: Let's swim from here to there.

lines.py: tā yǐ jīng yóu le bàn xiǎo shí .
lines.en: She's been swimming for half an hour.

lines.zh: 我不会游泳，你教我好吗？
lines.py: wǒ bù huì yóu yǒng , nǐ jiào wǒ hǎo ma ?
lines.en: I can't swim. Would you teach me?

lines.py: wǒ men míng tiān qù yóu yǒng .
lines.en: Let's go swimming tomorrow.
